text:
NovaMesh is building the next-generation multi-tenant infrastructure layer for data-driven apps. We're a tight engineering team moving fast to deliver a resilient, programmable platform that lets product teams deploy services and pipelines with minimal ops overhead. We're looking for a Senior Platform Engineer who loves systems programming, distributed protocols and shipping reliable infrastructure.

What you'll do
- Design and implement core control-plane and data-plane services in Go to power multi-tenant service meshes and platform APIs.
- Build and maintain high-performance gRPC services, defining protobuf contracts and ensuring backward compatibility.
- Own scalability and reliability: optimize RPC performance, implement load balancing, health checks, observability and graceful upgrades.
- Collaborate with SRE and product teams to define SLIs/SLOs, implement alerting and incident playbooks, and participate in on-call rotations.
- Integrate platform components with identity, networking and storage systems; contribute to CI/CD, testing and release automation.
- Mentor mid and junior engineers; drive architecture discussions and code reviews.

What we need (mandatory)
- 6-10 years experience
- Strong proficiency in Go
- Proven experience building and maintaining gRPC-based services

Bonus points (preferred / good-to-have)
- AWS
- Apache Kafka

Location and work mode
Delhi NCR, on-site 5 days a week. No remote option.
